description: CrowdSec Agent for Windows # Version 1.8.2 • Brings [custom JS fingerprinting capabilities](https://docs.crowdsec.net/docs/next/appsec/bot_detection/custom_js/) to the bot detection feature, allowing both users and us to distribute detection rules directly via the hub. • Brings [rate limiting feature](https://docs.crowdsec.net/docs/next/appsec/rate_limiting/) to the WAF. • Brings performance improvements to the Security Engine, optimizing both memory copy behaviors and relying on static analysis to avoid processing unnecessary regular expressions. • Brings performance improvements to the WAF, optimizing out-of-band rules processing. • Brings performance improvements to the Bot Detection, optimizing memory usage. ## New Features & Major improvements • [WAF] Add
